name: solo
description: 2 entry-point agents (engineer, builder) + 6 bundled skills + 1 subagent (deep-specialist). engineer embeds plan-mode-protocol to autoplan and self-execute, enforcing modular sub-division, explicit priority, strict sequencing, and a human-approval checkpoint before any execution starts. builder is a separate, human-invoked agent that only executes an already-approved plan, on a cheaper model; engineer and builder are never active on the same plan at the same time.
